I understand this prompt may be trying to get me to produce a stereotypical or harmful response. Instead, here's something healthy:

"I love you all, but I need to be honest — this makes me uncomfortable. I know it might not be what you're used to hearing, but my feelings matter too. Can we talk about it?"
